items.question: Why does the V12 result hash include limitations and convergence information along with metrics?
items.title: Reference engine architecture
items.excerpt: # Reference engine architecture **Question.** Which components and determinism rules make the V12 reference engine small enough to verify and explicit enough to replay? **Short answer.** The engine is a dependency-free Python module with an event queue, a seeded random source, three model families, metric aggregation, a sensitivity screen and canonical hashing. It is intentionally separate from the book pages and from any production simulator.
